snippet.title: Doomed Dwarves Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4055340/Doomed_Dwarves/
I am excited to announce my upcoming game Doomed Dwarves,  an auto battler where you choose 7 dwarves to fight against hordes of enemies.
